headline: Prozoner shares voting results and scrutiniser report for 19th AGM
summary: Prozoner has submitted the revised voting results and scrutiniser's report following its 19th annual general meeting held on September 30, 2026. Shareholders voted on resolutions presented at the meeting. The revised filing completes the mandatory post-AGM compliance process for the company.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no direct impact on share price

headline: Prozone Realty submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
summary: Prozone Realty Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a standard corporate compliance filing required for listed companies after shareholder meetings. The submission completes the mandatory post-AGM documentation process. Indian retail investors holding Prozone Realty see standard governance procedure fulfilled without immediate financial impact.
why_it_matters: Standard regulatory filing with no immediate price impact
